problem: A public/chat web observer can refuse a direct fetch to bedrijfsgeheugen.nl even while Netlify production is healthy, creating a false-negative final verification if observer reachability is treated as production truth.
root_cause: Observer policy/capability was conflated with origin/runtime health.
failed_approach: Require every independent chat/web fetcher to reproduce the canonical production HTTP readback before accepting already-proven production.
fix: Separate observer availability from production authority. When the external observer is unavailable, require exact Netlify provider proof plus immutable GitHub lineage and expected function inventory; keep the canonical Production Release Readback workflow fail-closed.
